sources.snippet: Mineskin Diffusion v1.0 A quick and high-quality model for creating your owns Minecraft Skins This a new and rebuild version of old Minecraft Skin Diffusion models. Model have about 18 millions params, that make it a very fast and don't need a lot of memory. Model train in 30000 images of mans and girls skins.
